title: Yelp's new agent will call a restaurant and text you the wait
friendlyTitle: Yelp will call a restaurant for you and text back the wait
summary: Yelp's fall release adds Check for Me, an AI phone agent that calls an eligible restaurant, asks the wait for your party size, and texts you the answer. Yelp says it is rolling out over the coming months on iOS in the US, on restaurant pages where walk-ins are possible, and inside Yelp Assistant. The same release lets Yelp Assistant book OpenTable reservations in the chat, and adds Smart Lead Reply, which drafts and qualifies replies to incoming business leads.
friendlySummary: Yelp's autumn update adds Check for Me. An AI phone agent calls an eligible restaurant, asks how long the wait is for your group, and texts you the answer. Yelp says it is rolling out over the coming months on iPhone in the United States, on restaurant pages that take walk-ins, and inside Yelp Assistant. The same update lets Yelp Assistant book OpenTable reservations in the chat. It also adds Smart Lead Reply, which drafts and sorts replies to new customer enquiries for businesses.
whyItMatters: Checking a wait without sitting on hold is a small, concrete use of a voice agent. The restaurant still has to answer the call, and the feature is not on every listing yet. For a business, the other half of the release is an agent that answers a lead before a person does.
